model.name: PII units are never committable + traceability units are durable-by-construction (split the shared scenario/index path)
model.description: Today the running server mints EVERY class into scenario/index with NO git policy, so one `git add scenario/` (or git add -A) would COMMIT user Profiles and private chat Messages into the source repo — which is pushed — a PII EXPOSURE VECTOR one careless command away, by any agent. The SAME un-policied path also carries traceability units (a ChangeRequest is minted on every decline), which reach the repo only if a human notices = a durability hole. Two classes with OPPOSITE desired outcomes share ONE path, so which outcome you get is CHANCE. SPLIT the path by class: (a) traceability classes are durable-in-repo BY CONSTRUCTION; (b) PII/runtime classes are explicitly gitignored AND relocated out of scenario/index so they can NEVER be committed.

discoverySource.measured: 3 app-minted units untracked in git NOW = 1 Profile 76f2cda7 (Chris Ultrix) + 2 Message 2e157bb2/c1b3736e (chat); 0 traceability-class (CR 4babebb1 was the only one, now committed). NOTHING under scenario/ is gitignored (check-ignore exit=1) = NO POLICY. CR 4babebb1 was app-minted-but-git-untracked = how it evaporate-ably existed.

model.crossRefNote: Surfaced by the R40.1/#86 CR work (an app-minted CR was git-untracked). The single-declared-registry AC mirrors R40.39 type-strategy registry (omission-by-default -> RED); reuse that shape so a NEW class cannot silently fall into the wrong bucket.

acceptanceCriteria.text: PII/runtime classes (Profile, Message, Email, Phone, Room, Device) are stored OUTSIDE scenario/index (data/ or equivalent) AND explicitly gitignored, so `git add scenario/` or `git add -A` CANNOT stage any PII unit. KNOWN-excluded, not accidentally-retained.
A seeded PII unit that IS trackable under scenario/index (stageable by git add -A, or not gitignored) => RED. Privacy fails LOUD, never silently retained.

Traceability classes (ChangeRequest, Bug, Task, Test, Requirement, Implementation, Method, UseCase, Class, Sprint) minted by the app are durable-in-repo BY CONSTRUCTION — emitted through a git-tracked path or committed by the minting transaction, NEVER 'if a human notices'.
A seeded app-minted traceability unit (e.g. a CR minted on decline) that does NOT reach git => RED.

The 3 existing untracked PII units (Profile 76f2cda7 + Message 2e157bb2 + Message c1b3736e) are relocated out of scenario/index + gitignored, NEVER committed; any PII already in git history is FLAGGED for a separate scrub (dry-run + count, no PII pushed).

The class->bucket mapping (durable-traceability | pii-excluded) is ONE declared registry (same shape as R40.39 type-strategy registry), NOT scattered hardcoded lists; a class with units but no declared bucket => RED (fail-closed — a new class cannot silently fall into the wrong bucket).
